trans_id_delta.description: Modulo-65536 difference between current request TID and previous request TID in this communication channel. Normal Modbus sequentially increments by 1.
trans_id_delta.relevance: Replays often exhibit abrupt TID jumps or backwards wraps compared to the active session.

trans_id_raw_diff.description: Unbounded numerical difference (curr_tid - prev_tid) in communication channel.
trans_id_raw_diff.relevance: Captures raw positive or negative jumps when replayed bursts disrupt monotonic sequence.

tid_previously_seen.description: 1.0 if current TID was observed in the preceding bounded history window (default 100 transactions) in this channel, else 0.0.
tid_previously_seen.relevance: Direct indicator of TID reuse within a short operational timeframe.

request_iat.description: Inter-arrival time between this request and the preceding request in this communication channel.
request_iat.relevance: Attacker burst injection or replay timing deviations disrupt normal periodic polling rates.

time_since_identical_cmd.description: Elapsed seconds since the exact same observed-command fingerprint was sent in this channel (capped at 3600.0s sentinel if not yet observed).
time_since_identical_cmd.relevance: Measures polling periodicity and highlights burst repetition of replayed commands.

is_repeated_command.description: 1.0 if this observed-command fingerprint was previously observed in the channel history, else 0.0.
is_repeated_command.relevance: Contextual indicator that a command has prior presence in the capture.

repeated_cmd_count_window.description: Count of identical observed-command fingerprints occurring in the trailing time window (default 5.0 seconds).
repeated_cmd_count_window.relevance: Captures anomalous clustering of repeated commands indicative of rapid replay.

duplicate_cmd_freq.description: Rate of duplicate commands per second within the trailing time window.

outstanding_requests.description: Number of currently active, pending requests in the channel awaiting response when this request was sent.
outstanding_requests.relevance: Replay floods often generate backlog without corresponding responses.

modbus_func_code.description: Modbus Function Code (e.g., 1=Read Coils, 3=Read Holding Registers, 4=Read Input Registers).
modbus_func_code.relevance: Specifies command type and operation semantics.

mbtcp_unit_id.description: Modbus Unit ID / Slave address in MBAP header.

modbus_ref_num.description: Starting register reference / memory address queried by the command.

modbus_val.description: Modbus write value or single parameter.

payload_len.description: Total Modbus TCP application payload length in bytes.

is_matched.description: 1.0 if a matching server response was received within timeout, 0.0 otherwise.
is_matched.relevance: Validates whether the transaction was acknowledged by an active server.

is_timeout.description: 1.0 if the transaction timed out with missing response, 0.0 otherwise.
is_timeout.relevance: Replays injected into closed or invalid sessions often produce no server response.

is_ambiguous.description: 1.0 if multiple identical outstanding requests matched the response, 0.0 otherwise.
is_ambiguous.relevance: Identifies transaction collision caused by replayed duplicate TIDs.

response_latency.description: Round-trip time (response_time - request_time) for matched transactions, or imputed timeout sentinel if missing.
response_latency.relevance: Legitimate Modbus responses exhibit consistent low server latency.

has_response_latency.description: Missingness indicator: 1.0 if response_latency is genuinely observed, 0.0 if imputed due to timeout.
has_response_latency.relevance: Allows the tree model to distinguish genuine low-latency responses from imputed timeouts.
